title.en: Kilograms and grams: reading scales, converting, comparing

text.en: Anu wrote the weight of things in her house: iron almirah 40 g, bed 60 kg, rice bag 5 kg, refrigerator 50 g. Something is wrong - can a whole almirah weigh as little as a few coins? Let us learn to measure and judge weights like a shopkeeper.

We measure weight in grams (g) and kilograms (kg). 1 kg = 1,000 g. Small things like a water bottle's contents or a pencil are weighed in grams; big things like a rice bag, a bed or an almirah in kilograms.
Check Anu's list by common sense: an iron almirah is about 40 kg (not 40 g), a refrigerator about 50 kg (not 50 g), a bed 60 kg, a rice bag 5 kg, and a water bottle 650 g is right.
To read a weighing scale, first look at what one small mark stands for. If 1 kg is divided into 4 parts, each mark is 250 g. If it has 2 parts, each mark is 500 g. The pointer at the first mark after 2 kg reads 2 kg 250 g.
Two scales may show the same bag differently: one in kg and another in g. A bag of 2 kg shows 2,000 g on the other scale. A double number line helps: every kg step on top matches 1,000 g below, so we multiply by 1,000.
To change kg and g to grams: 3 kg 500 g = 3,000 g + 500 g = 3,500 g. Shrenu's kitchen scale shows only grams, so for 2 kg 250 g of flour it must show 2,250 g.
Be careful with the zeros. 5 kg 50 g = 5,000 g + 50 g = 5,050 g, not 5,500 g. Shamim was right and Rehan was wrong, because 50 g is much less than 500 g.
To change grams back, split at the thousands: 10,760 g = 10 kg 760 g, 4,080 g = 4 kg 80 g and 12,042 g = 12 kg 42 g.
To compare, bring both weights to the same unit. 1 kg 600 g = 1,600 g, which is less than 1,700 g. And 1 kg 600 g is more than 1 kg 60 g, because 600 g is more than 60 g.
Picnic fruits: watermelon 3 kg, pineapple 1 kg 750 g, apples 1 kg 250 g, mangoes 2 kg. In descending order: watermelon, mangoes, pineapple, apples. Watermelon is the heaviest and apples the lightest.

problem.en: Convert 8 kg 69 g to grams and say which is heavier: 8 kg 69 g or 8,609 g.

why.en: Place the 69 in the last two places of the grams part, using a 0 as a placeholder.

text.en: Compare 8,069 g with 8,609 g: 8,609 is greater.

why.en: Compare thousands first, then hundreds: 8,0.. is smaller than 8,6..

prompt.en: Explain to a friend how to change 4 kg 80 g into grams and why it is not 4,800 g.

requiredIdeas.en: 4 kg = 4,000 g, add 80 g to get 4,080 g
80 g is a small number, so it needs a 0 before it

commonMisconceptions.en: Writing 4,800 g by putting 80 next to 4 as 800

points.en: 1 kg = 1,000 g and 1 g is a very small weight.
kg to g: multiply by 1,000; for kg and g together add the grams afterwards.
g to kg: 12,042 g = 12 kg 42 g.
Compare weights after bringing them to the same unit.
Use common sense: big things in kg, small things in g.
